secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: a restricted Stripe key that may create Checkout Sessions (Developers → API keys → restricted key, write on Checkout Sessions)

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: the signing secret of the Stripe webhook endpoint that points at this app's inbound address (Developers → Webhooks; send checkout.session.completed and checkout.session.expired)
